name: set_civic_progress
description: Set a player's culture progress on a specific civic to an exact value (or a fraction of its cost), via Player:GetCulture():SetCulturalProgress(civicIndex, culture) in GameCore_Tuner (Firaxis Debug/Player.ltp civic list, which sets it to GetCultureCost to complete). Partial alternative to grant_civic: shave turns off a civic or set it back. Verified live turn 60: Military Tradition 26.75/50 -> 40 took turns left 10 -> 5 (InGame GetCulturalProgress and GetTurnsLeft matched exactly), and setting 26.7461 restored 10 turns. Setting >= cost should complete it at the next culture processing (not tested). Params: civic (CIVIC_* type, required), progress (absolute culture points) or fraction (0-1 of the civic's cost; one of the two required), playerId (default local player). Returns the civic's cost and turns-left-on-current-civic before/after; exact progress must be read InGame (GameCore Culture has no GetCulturalProgress).

fraction.description: fraction of the civic's culture cost (0-1), used if progress omitted

lua:
local pid = P.playerId or Game.GetLocalPlayer()
local pl = Players[pid]
if not pl then emitJson({error="no player "..tostring(pid)}); return end
local row = GameInfo.Civics[P.civic]
if not row then emitJson({error="unknown civic "..tostring(P.civic)}); return end
local cu = pl:GetCulture()
local cost = cu:GetCultureCost(row.Index)
local target = P.progress
if target == nil and P.fraction ~= nil then target = cost * P.fraction end
if target == nil then emitJson({error="give progress or fraction", cost=cost, turnsLeftCurrentCivic=cu:GetTurnsLeftOnCurrentCivic()}); return end
if target < 0 then target = 0 end
local t0 = cu:GetTurnsLeftOnCurrentCivic()
cu:SetCulturalProgress(row.Index, target)
emitJson({playerId=pid, civic=row.CivicType, cost=cost, setTo=target, turnsLeftCurrentCivicBefore=t0, turnsLeftCurrentCivicAfter=cu:GetTurnsLeftOnCurrentCivic(), note="read exact progress InGame: GetCulture():GetCulturalProgress(index)"})
